topic: $6 Steam game Data Center teaches infrastructure
new_body_text: A **$6 Steam game** is explaining data centers better than most courses
new_caption:
A $6 game on Steam is teaching people how data centers actually work, and it's getting attention fast.

The game is called Data Center. You start with empty floors and build from scratch — buy racks, mount servers, route every cable by hand. The goal is to design and manage a functioning data center that handles real customer traffic.

What makes it stand out is how it visualizes network activity. Customer traffic appears as colored balls rolling through your cables in real time, so you can physically see where bottlenecks form and where your layout is failing.

Data centers power AI training, cloud computing, and enterprise systems — and most people still have no idea how they actually operate. For six dollars, this game may be doing more to explain modern computing infrastructure than most courses or explainers ever have.

Follow @metawareai for more.
